_note: Source of truth for the project grids. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/sync.py` (or let the GitHub Action do it). The featured build of each section is hand-written in index.html and is intentionally excluded from its grid. New projects found in a repo are appended automatically with `new: true`.

projects.title: SIMT Reconvergence (IPDOM) Stack
projects.desc: Per-warp LIFO of {pc, rpc, active-mask} performing immediate-post-dominator reconvergence for SIMT branch divergence, with exact per-lane mask conservation.

projects.title: Output-Stationary Systolic GEMM
projects.desc: N×N output-stationary MAC mesh in TPU-style dataflow, with diagonal space-time skew scheduling and overflow-proof signed accumulators.

projects.title: SIMT Bank-Conflict Crossbar
projects.desc: Shared-memory crossbar resolving bank conflicts by leader-select scheduling, with same-address broadcast collapsing and a pending-mask retire loop.

projects.title: Memory-Coalescing Unit
projects.desc: GPU LSU front-end coalescing per-lane byte addresses into the minimum aligned cache-line transactions via single-pass parallel leader detection.

projects.title: 2:4 Structured-Sparsity Engine
projects.desc: Sparse Tensor-Core datapath computing dot-products over 2:4 structured-sparse weights, with per-group index-metadata decode and 4:1 selection.

projects.title: Hardware Priority Queue
projects.desc: Systolic register-array min-priority-queue with single-cycle enqueue and extract-min at occupancy-independent latency, kept sorted by parallel compare / shift-insert.

projects.title: Streaming Top-K Engine
projects.desc: Systolic sorted-insertion array keeping the K largest (key, tag) pairs of a 1-element/clock stream — LLM top-K sampling, beam search, k-NN.

projects.title: Segmented Prefix-Sum (Kogge-Stone)
projects.desc: Pipelined Kogge-Stone parallel prefix-sum with per-lane head-flag segmented scan and OR-scan flag propagation, one vector per clock.

projects.title: IEEE-754 binary32 FP Adder
projects.desc: Single-precision adder with exponent-align barrel shift, round-to-nearest-even (guard/round/sticky), subnormals and Inf/NaN special-casing.

projects.title: Radix-4 Booth Multiplier

projects.title: Parallel CRC-32 (Ethernet FCS)

projects.title: Bitonic Sorting Network

projects.title: CORDIC Sine / Cosine
